attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (10.11.18) across node1/node2/node3 on CentOS Stream 10, took it fully down for a simulated maintenance window, brought it back with all committed writes intact, then individually restarted (native reboot) each node one at a time and verified changed boot identity plus post-reboot cluster health/data on all three.
